merge_basis: T0021 concerns Obrixtamig (BI 764532) Phase 3 study 1438-0011 (Dareon-Nec-1) for 1L epNEC CTA submission, whereas the only existing Obrixtamig group (G0017) covers study 1438-0032, which is an epidemiology study for 2L epNEC. Different study numbers, different study types (Phase 3 interventional vs. epidemiology), and different lines of therapy; these are distinct topics.
